verdict.rationale: Fastmail has first-party help articles for both aliases (fastmail-docs-12/36) and Masked Email (fastmail-docs-18/29). A community user independently confirms masked emails work well for throwaway or sketchy sign-ups (fastmail-comm-1). The doc evidence is title-only, so the depth of the capability is not shown. Missing for 10: substantive doc content on how masked addresses hide the real address (e.g. sending from a mask, disabling or deleting masks), and hands-on evidence for aliases beyond the doc title.
